characters.name: Shiva
characters.overall_description: A cosmic ascetic seated in divine stillness, the god of destruction and rebirth, embodying power, serenity, and timeless mystery.

visual_details.skin_tone: Ash-grey with a subtle celestial glow
visual_details.hair_style: Long, thick, coiled into a high jata with strands flowing
visual_details.eye_color: Glowing deep blue with a vertical third eye in fiery orange
visual_details.clothing_style: Minimal ascetic attire with sacred symbolism and tiger skin wrap
visual_details.accessories: Crescent moon on forehead, damaru in hand, serpent coiled around neck, rudraksha beads, Ganga flowing from hair
visual_details.notable_features: Third eye on forehead, glowing aura, ash-smeared skin, silent commanding presence, seated in meditative posture

characters.name: Nandi
characters.overall_description: Shiva’s divine bull companion and guardian, symbolizing unwavering devotion, patience, and strength.

visual_details.body_type: Massive, extremely muscular bull form with broad chest and strong limbs
visual_details.skin_tone: Radiant white with a silvery sheen and divine glow
visual_details.hair_style: Smooth fur with a curly tuft on forehead and flowing tail hair
visual_details.eye_color: Golden brown with deep, serene pupils
visual_details.clothing_style: Regal divine ornaments and draped sacred cloth
visual_details.accessories: Decorated saddle cloth with sacred symbols, golden anklets, divine bell, ornamental forehead marking
visual_details.notable_features: Statue-like stillness, glowing horns, eyes filled with pure devotion, presence radiating calm

characters.name: Serpent
characters.overall_description: A mystical serpent coiled across Shiva’s shoulders, representing primal energy, cosmic awareness, and divine guardianship.

visual_details.body_type: Long, thick, grotesquely muscular serpent with sinuous strength
visual_details.skin_tone: Metallic emerald with dark obsidian stripes and glowing undertones
visual_details.hair_style: Glossy ridged scales running along spine like a mohawk
visual_details.eye_color: Fiery crimson with elliptical pupils radiating light
visual_details.clothing_style: Mystical adornment of glowing sigils patterned into scales
visual_details.accessories: Embedded ancient runes along spine, flickering aura around fangs, mystic smoke trailing from mouth
visual_details.notable_features: Forked tongue emitting low hum, piercing gaze, tense coiled posture, glowing scale markings
